title: One goroutine owns the state
hints: NewStore starts a goroutine that owns the map. It loops on a select over s.reads and s.writes and is the only code that ever touches the map.
Each request carries its own response channel. Get sends a readOp and then waits on its resp. Set sends a writeOp and waits for the acknowledgement on its resp.
In the owner: case r := <-s.reads: r.resp <- state[r.key]; case w := <-s.writes: state[w.key] = w.val; w.resp <- struct{}{}.  Get: resp := make(chan int); s.reads <- readOp{key, resp}; return <-resp
